hook_plan.runtime_isolation: Owned filtered export with its own Git directory, verified Node22 and released fresh workspace dependencies only. Explicit child environment omits HOME, inherited NODE_OPTIONS, ENV, BASH_ENV, service/provider values and bypass settings. Supply fresh XDG_CONFIG_HOME, empty owned npm user/global config and owned cache/temp paths. Do not copy shell/Husky init, user npm or credential directories. Keep HOME absent rather than repurposing it.
hook_plan.dispatchers: In the fresh export, use the existing installed Husky lifecycle to generate .husky/_ and select that genuine hook path in the new repository. Verify dispatcher/executable modes and tracked-hook/config byte parity. prepare tolerates failure, so exit0 alone is insufficient. Do not modify the original repository config or disable/replace hook behavior.
hook_plan.identity_transport: Later integration owner must establish the existing approved identity, signing requirements and authenticated transport without credential/config dumps or blocked file loading. If that cannot be done, stop for root resolution.
hook_plan.failure_policy: Hook failures block the operation. No HUSKY=0, --no-verify, forced push, fake commands, unchecked hook edits or restored real user environment.
